title: Mepivacaine vs. Bupivacaine Spinal Anesthetic in Total Knee Arthroplasty
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if a shorter-acting spinal anesthetic called mepivacaine has advantages over a longer-acting medication called bupivacaine.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients undergoing primary total knee arthroplasty

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chronic opioid users
* Unable to give informed consent
* Forego the use of a foley catheter
* Those with hypersensitively to amide local anesthetics or opioids
* Those with contraindications to spinal anesthesia
* Conversion to general anesthesia will be excluded.
